functional.scope: Real WorkerThreadPool tasks and exact hashing/reconstruction/texture bytes; synthetic deterministic loader tokens and pump clock. A semaphore explicitly keeps selected tasks incomplete for cancellation/lifetime assertions. One injected non-disposing join error tests ownership retry; normal engine joins remain real. No filesystem decode throughput, whole-game frame pacing, physical-input or speed claim.
functional.per_generation_note: Successful reconfigure resets public task counters; the fixture retains actual join/token counters across that boundary.

closed_status.memory_scope: Logical retained validation payloads and conservative Image/copy/reconstruction overlap only; excludes hash context, dictionaries, pool resources, allocator/COW behavior, resident textures and driver memory. Not RSS.

scope: Real native ResourceLoader and ImageTexture, exact predecessor vs isolated worker-hash prototype. Four views include full and cropped single-tile admission to expose extra polling latency. Worker elapsed intervals are recorded separately; they can overlap main-thread work and must not be added to it or described as GPU time. Only main-thread whole-pump calls and their nested stages form the submission measurements. Two warmup plus six measured fresh streams per view; sequential fully closed arms alternate and reversed process is separate. OS cache is uncontrolled; no cold-disk claim. One pump per process frame, whole call and nested stage clocks; stage sums are not an additive frame breakdown. Readiness wall/frames include diagnostic status collection and frame scheduling; endpoint pixel readback/hash is outside all pump clocks and delays subsequent phases. Construction/configuration costs are excluded; endpoint readback costs are recorded separately. Walking reports every unready frame without pausing its trace; endpoint drains are explicit. All retained endpoint textures are verified against exact manifest pixels without retaining evicted textures. Cancellation requires a naturally observed partial job; absence of that witness on faster hardware is a fixture limitation. No Bootstrap travel, foreground, FPS, GPU execution, physical input or hard2ms latency guarantee.
interpretation_limits: No production code is changed; exact source hashes bind these isolated prototypes only.
Arrival p95 pools whole pump calls through full halo drain, not gameplay frame intervals. First-ready pump count adds one to the raw zero-based completion index.
Twelve measured sequential arm pairs per view across two processes; two warmup cycles/process remain raw. OS/resource/driver cache history is uncontrolled.
Main CPU and worker elapsed can overlap. Their sum is not critical-path or process CPU time; worker time can include descheduling.
Texture creation is driver submission and endpoint readback is excluded from pump clocks; no GPU execution claim.
Early walking is 24 fixed camera-demand samples, not actual Bootstrap or human input. Required latency of one-tile cases must remain separate from larger-view improvement.
Functional tasks are genuine, but loader tokens/pump clock are synthetic; the injected join failure is a non-disposing error control.
Stored validation payloads and conservative transient overlap are logical counts, not RSS or a hard memory ceiling.
